newsitem.title: USA: Ariz. Four Corners 750 MW coal-fired unit back up.
newsitem.headline: Ariz. Four Corners 750 MW coal-fired unit back up.

text.p: The 750-megawatt (MW) unit 5 at the Four Corners coal-fired power plant in Arizona is back to full power, as expected, a spokesman for Arizona Public Service Co, the plant's operator, said Wednesday.
The unit was shut Friday night due to accumlation of ash in part of its boiler. It began to restart late Tuesday.
The plant's other units, another with a 750-MW capacity, two at 175 MW and another at 200 MW, are operating at normal rates, the spokesman said.
APS, a subsidiary of Pinnacle West Capital Corp, has a 15 percent stake in Four Corners' units 4 and 5, while Edison International's Southern California Edison Co holds a 48 percent stake.
